title: enginesave list --json
description: Output of `enginesave list --repo DIR --json`. cleaned_at appears only after a cleanup (0.4.0), install_present since 0.7.0, orphan_record_dirs since 0.8.0, stats since 0.9.0 (D56); latest_snapshot_at, latest_reason, latest_from_install, installs and stats.mirror_folder since 1.2.0 (D73).

latest_snapshot_at.description: 1.2.0 (D73 5): when latest_snapshot (the newest of any reason) was made, ISO-8601 UTC

latest_reason.description: 1.2.0 (D73 5): manual, auto, import or pre_restore; null without snapshots or when its manifest cannot be read

latest_from_install.description: 1.2.0 (D73 14): the install latest_snapshot was backed up from, when it says

installs.description: 1.2.0 (D73 5): every install folder the record knows, the most recently seen first; one that is gone stays listed (present false)

game_version.description: the game version last read there (Ren'Py config.version, a package.json version...)

present.description: the folder is on disk now

snapshots.description: every snapshot read for the byte counts (0.10.0: record folders the catalog does not name too; unreadable manifests counted)

stored_bytes.description: objects, plain copies, manifests and record files

logical_bytes.description: every snapshot's files as if each were stored on its own

last_backup.description: the newest manual or imported snapshot's time (0.10.0; before: the newest of any kind), ISO-8601 UTC

last_mirror.description: when this repository was last mirrored on this computer (mirrors.json beside gui.json)

mirror_folder.description: 1.2.0 (D73 16): where that mirror is (backup --mirror mirrors there); null when it was never mirrored on this computer
